scope: A contemporary Japanese-inspired stroll garden for the virtual campus, not a reconstruction of a historic garden.

sources.usedFor: Distinguishing pond, sand-and-stone and tea gardens; stone groupings, stepping stones, water basins and restrained planting.
Asymmetrical balance, naturalistic rocks and moss, composed paths, restrained materials and raked gravel.
Changing views along a stroll and the relationship between water, space and garden scenery.
Framing distant background planting as part of a layered garden view.

implementation: Maple leaves and pine needles with distinct geometry
Decorative koi and wind controlled by the existing Animation and quality settings
limits: Planting and carpentry are visual interpretations; no claim of botanical, structural or historical reconstruction accuracy.
